name: Geas

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a creature you can see that can understand you

upcast.text: With a level 7 or 8 slot it lasts 365 days; with a level 9 slot it lasts until ended by one of the spells above.

summary: Bind a creature to a task: Wis save or it is Charmed and hurt when it disobeys.
text: A target that can understand you is Charmed for the duration and takes 5d10 Psychic damage (at most once a day) when it acts directly against your command. Remove Curse, Greater Restoration or Wish ends it.
